faq.q: Can I mute task execution voice announcements on the phone speaker while keeping hands-free audio in my car or headphones?
faq.a: Yes. Sol Next v9.2.0 defaults to Headset & Car Bluetooth mode (silent on speakers, auto-enabled on wired/USB/Bluetooth earphones and car audio) and lets you switch to Off or Always in Settings.

faq.q: Can I toggle System Zero-Animation Turbo on or off?
faq.a: Yes. Settings > Virtual Screen & Task Automation provides a dedicated toggle that restores your phone's exact original window/transition/animator scales whenever disabled.

faq.q: Is Sol Next free and open-source with zero required API keys?
faq.a: Yes. Apache-2.0 open-source, free, and ships with Rust-vault-sealed DeepSeek Flash, Brave Search real-time web grounding, and a 4-stage on-device neural voice stack out of the box.

faq.q: Does Sol Next fix CJK IME typing lag and keyboard collisions on Android?
faq.a: Yes. v9.2.0 rebuilds the composer on Compose TextFieldState (PartialGapBuffer), isolates 30fps virtual screen frames to leaf composables, auto-dismisses the IME on drawer open, and auto-tucks the collapsed PiP while typing.
